assessments.name: Technical Design Report (final)
assessments.description: A technical report on the proposed technology solution.
assessments.dueRaw: Formal exam period Due date : 18 Nov 2026 at 23:59

assessments.name: Individual Design Process Review
assessments.description: This individual oral examination, worth 15% and conducted towards the end of the semester, assesses each student's understanding of the biomedical engineering design process and their contribution to the team project.

assessments.name: Clinical Need Analysis and Design Intent
assessments.description: This early assessment task, worth 5% and due in Week 3, requires student teams to interpret a clinician's brief and demonstrate their understanding of the underlying clinical need, stakeholders, intended use, and project constraints.

assessments.name: Technical Design Report (Draft)
assessments.description: A draft technical report on the proposed technology solution.

assessments.name: Quiz
assessments.description: Paper based in-class quiz covering lecture material.

assessments.name: Video Presentation
assessments.description: In this component of the Final Design Pitch, each group will submit a recorded video presentation pitching their proposed design solution.

assessments.name: Group Design Defence (Q&A)
assessments.description: Each group will submit a recorded video presentation prior to the assessment session. During the allocated session, the video will be played and followed by a live Q&A, where the team will be expected to defend and justify their final design.
assessments.type: Q&A following presentation, submission or placement
